name: code
title: Code
description: Literal text in the mono face, inline or as a block.
use: What a reader types as text or reads from a program: a command, a value, a file name, a listing. Inline it is a chip in the line; as a block it is a well that scrolls sideways. The stylesheet does not highlight syntax.

instead.when: It is a key to press, not text to type

keyboard.action: Scroll a block that carries tabindex="0", as any scroll container does

classes.name: code
classes.description: Inline code, on a <code>: a small chip in the line

classes.name: code-block
classes.description: A block of code, on a <pre>: a well whose lines keep their breaks and scroll sideways. Give it tabindex="0" when a line can be longer than the block

classes.name: code-line
classes.description: One line of a block, on a <code> or a <span>. With lines marked, the block lays them out as a grid and each is as wide as the longest

classes.name: code-line-highlight
classes.description: The line being talked about: a tint, and a 2px rule of ink at its start

classes.name: code-line-added
classes.description: An added line of a diff, in the success hue; keep the + in the text

classes.name: code-line-removed
classes.description: A removed line of a diff, in the danger hue; keep the - in the text

classes.name: code-numbered
classes.description: Numbers the code-line elements of the block with a CSS counter, in a gutter that is not selected or copied

classes.name: code-panel
classes.description: One well around a header and a block; the block inside gives up its own well

classes.name: code-header
classes.description: A 40px strip over the block, with the name at the start and a control at the end. A copy button there needs a script that hands the block's text to the clipboard

classes.name: code-title
classes.description: The name of the file or of the language, in the header

properties.name: --code-radius
properties.description: Circular radius of a standalone block before the corner scale

properties.name: --code-radius
properties.description: Circular radius of the panel before the corner scale, also used by its inset controls; use var(--radius-surface) when held directly in a tray

example:
Install the package with npm install @master/ui, then import it in your stylesheet.

@import '@master/css';
@import '@master/ui';
